assessments.reasoning: Section 9 at [17885,19211) in https://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/Licenses/fdl-1.3.txt specifies permanent reinstatement from the notifying holder and supplies each tested qualification. The surrounding paragraphs distinguish provisional reinstatement, permanent reinstatement after cessation without timely notice, and the position of recipients.

limitations: The effect of notice under another GNU FDL edition is unresolved here. Reasonableness, receipt, holder identity and cure in an actual case require facts beyond the license text.
reasoning: Following termination under §9, the first-notice route permanently reinstates the license from the particular notifying holder. Three conditions govern that result. The holder gives notice by reasonable means, the licensee has received no previous notice from that holder of a violation of this License for any work, and the licensee cures before 30 days have elapsed from receipt.
